title: What coding agents ran in this repository, 14-16 November 2026
question: How do Codex agents actually use the ci CLI and direct tools when working in this repository, and where do they spend commands and output?
method: Stdlib extraction over Codex rollout logs for 14-16 November whose session cwd is this repository; every exec_command is classified by leading tool and aggregated. Forked-subagent history replays are excluded. Raw logs stay outside the repository.

outputs.role: Readable tables for every measured topic
ci commands piped into another tool

conclusion: Agents run tests and checks almost entirely through ci (758 ci test launches against 9 direct pytest calls), read failures with --json and reduce them in inline Python, hold results they cannot attribute to a consumer, and spend more than half of all commands reading and searching source. Established for this three-day window, which one plan (DDO) dominates. Not established: agent intent, what the piped scripts extract, and whether multi-file edit scripts are mechanical renames; the usage-error table keeps only the first line of each error and undercounts 'No such option' errors.
